scope: Post-confirmation training-budget diagnostic on the registered 2.0-second RAVDESS raster target; no new registered gate.
question: Does the same-target constant-audio advantage persist when both fitted conditions receive up to 80 epochs under the original patience-six validation rule?
controlled_settings: Start both conditions afresh for each seed with identical actor split, features, 64x64 target, AudioFiLM model, AdamW learning rate 0.0003, weight decay 0.0001, batch size 64, patience 6, and validation-MAE checkpoint selection. Only the maximum epoch budget changes from 40 to 80 relative to the earlier seed check. Score every selected pair on the same 240 opened confirmation targets.
analysis: Report every seed and actor, selected epochs, and constant-minus-aligned MAE. Compare 40- and 80-epoch selected checkpoints descriptively, without treating seeds or repeated target rows as independent test populations.
